SYMBAROUMHUD.Title: Symbaroum HUD
SYMBAROUMHUD.Empty: Select a character or creature token.

CharacterCreator.Title: New character sheet
CharacterCreator.Heading: How would you like to create this character?
CharacterCreator.Description: You can fill in the sheet freely or use the Character Creator, which will guide each creation step according to the Symbaroum rules.
CharacterCreator.DecisionHint: Closing this window without choosing will show the question again the next time the sheet opens.

Occupation.Title: Character Creator — Choose Your Occupation
Occupation.IndexHint: Choose a name from the index to learn about its place in the world and style of adventure.
Occupation.SelectionHint: Your occupation guides your concept but does not restrict the character's future choices.

berserker.Name: Berserker
berserker.Summary: A combatant who turns fury and endurance into weapons. They stride into danger without hesitation and trust their strength to remain standing.
berserker.Playstyle: Ideal for players who want to meet enemies up close, endure punishment, and make a strong physical impact.

duelist.Name: Duelist
duelist.Summary: A specialist in precision, mobility, and command of the blade. They prevail through technique and by choosing the right moment to attack or defend.
duelist.Playstyle: Suited to players who favor agility, finesse, and careful combat decisions.

captain.Name: Captain
captain.Summary: A leader accustomed to turning individuals into a coordinated force. Their presence inspires allies and restores order when everything threatens to collapse.
captain.Playstyle: Supports leadership, social interaction, and tactical assistance for the whole group.

sellsword.Name: Sellsword
sellsword.Summary: A pragmatic veteran who trades steel and experience for payment. They survived by changing tactics whenever the job demanded it.
sellsword.Playstyle: A versatile choice for martial competence without strict vows or traditions.

knight.Name: Knight
knight.Summary: A disciplined, armored warrior driven by duty, honor, or loyalty. They often stand between danger and their companions.
knight.Playstyle: Well suited to defense, protecting allies, and making a strong impression in and out of battle.

witch.Name: Witch
witch.Summary: A mystic tied to clan traditions, spirits, and the wild rhythms of Davokar. Their power grows from pacts, memory, and respect for the living world.
witch.Playstyle: Combines magic, spiritual perception, and a strong bond with nature and barbarian culture.

sorcerer.Name: Sorcerer
sorcerer.Summary: An occultist who faces forbidden powers and Corruption in ways few would dare. The path offers strength but demands constant vigilance.
sorcerer.Playstyle: For players interested in dark magic, risk, and difficult choices involving Corruption.

theurg.Name: Theurg
theurg.Summary: A mystical servant of Prios who channels faith, light, and religious authority. They may protect the living, confront darkness, and represent the Church.
theurg.Playstyle: Blends sacred powers, group support, and ties to Ambrian faith and institutions.

wizard.Name: Wizard
wizard.Summary: A scholar trained by the Ordo Magica to understand and control the supernatural through method, discipline, and research.
wizard.Playstyle: Favors knowledge, preparation, and an academic approach to powers and mysteries.

selfTaughtMystic.Name: Self-taught Mystic
selfTaughtMystic.Summary: An independent practitioner taught by intuition, fragments of lore, or unusual encounters. Their freedom comes with suspicion and danger.
selfTaughtMystic.Playstyle: Offers broad conceptual freedom with less protection from the risks of mystical practice.

charlatan.Name: Charlatan
charlatan.Summary: A master of stories, disguises, and half-truths. They open doors by learning what others want to hear — and when it is time to disappear.
charlatan.Playstyle: Excels in social scenes, infiltration, bluffing, and creative solutions that avoid direct conflict.

witchhunter.Name: Witchhunter
witchhunter.Summary: A relentless investigator of cults, abominations, and corrupt practices. They combine knowledge of the enemy with the resolve to pursue it to the end.
witchhunter.Playstyle: Works well in investigation, tracking, and confrontations with supernatural threats.

thug.Name: Thug
thug.Summary: A street survivor versed in intimidation, ambushes, and unceremonious violence. They do what is needed when manners stop working.
thug.Playstyle: Combines strength, opportunism, and contacts in urban or marginal environments.

treasureHunter.Name: Treasure-hunter
treasureHunter.Summary: An explorer drawn to ruins, artifacts, and buried secrets. Every discovery in Davokar may bring fortune — or something far worse.
treasureHunter.Playstyle: Excellent for exploration, knowledge of ruins, traps, and the search for artifacts.

ranger.Name: Ranger
ranger.Summary: A scout used to dangerous trails, long watches, and untamed lands. They find paths where others see only forest and darkness.
ranger.Playstyle: Favors survival, tracking, reconnaissance, and ranged combat.

Storage.NoBackpackShort: No backpack: items are in pockets

Abilities.AddPrompt: Choose a world ability to buy at Novice level.

MysticalPowers.Empty: This character has no mystical powers.

Rituals.AddPrompt: Choose a world ritual to add to the character.
Rituals.AdditionalEnabled: Can learn beyond the base limit

Attacks.DrawPrompt: {weapon} is not drawn. Do you want to draw it? Then click the weapon again to attack.
Attacks.DrawMovementReminder: Remember: drawing a weapon costs a movement action.

Vitality.Title: Change Toughness
Vitality.Prompt: Type +3 to heal or -9 to take damage and press Enter. You can also enter the amount and use the buttons below.

Corruption.Title: Change temporary Corruption
Corruption.Prompt: Enter an amount and choose whether the character should reduce or gain temporary Corruption. Permanent Corruption will not be changed.

Enabled.Name: Enable Symbaroum HUD
Enabled.Hint: Displays the persistent HUD on this client.

SelectionMode.Name: Actor source
SelectionMode.Hint: Defines how the HUD chooses the displayed actor.

ShowIndResources.Name: Ind Resources integration
ShowIndResources.Hint: Shows Symbaroum Ind Resources data and actions while it is active.

ShowWeaponReadinessButton.Name: Show separate weapon readiness button
ShowWeaponReadinessButton.Hint: Displays the Ind Resources draw and sheathe button before the hotbar slots. Drawing weapons from the Attacks panel remains available while this option is disabled.

HidePlayers.Name: Hide player list
HidePlayers.Hint: Hides the player and performance panel in the lower-left corner for this client.

Maneuvers.Prompt: Choose an Ind Resources maneuver to roll.
